tasks.label: 论文: 完整编译为 PDF (pdflatex+bibtex)
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex >/dev/null 2>&1 && bibtex main >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex >/dev/null 2>&1 && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && echo '=== 编译完成: paper/main.pdf ==='

tasks.label: 论文: 快速编译 (仅 pdflatex 一次)
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex && echo '=== 快速编译完成: paper/main.pdf ==='

tasks.label: 论文: 清理中间文件
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/paper && rm -f main.aux main.bbl main.blg main.log main.out main.pdf && echo '=== 已清理 paper 编译产物 ==='
